name: Detective Hunt - Crownston City PD
source:
Detective Hunt - Crownston City PD is a noir visual novel!

You are Damien Hunt, a junior detective of the Crownston City Police Department. Together with your partner, you are to investigate criminal activities around the city. You grew up hearing that the city is so safe, so beautiful... but is it?

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/464240/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《侦探汉特：皇冠斯顿市警察局》是一部黑色电影风格的视觉小说！

你将扮演克朗斯顿市警察局的初级侦探达米恩·汉特。和搭档一起调查城市中的犯罪活动。你从小就听说这座城市安全、美丽……但事实真是如此吗？

[来源：[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/464240/]Steam[/url]]
